poems.edit: How the World Works, a first book, 2022, and one a day on the home page, chosen by the day’s weather. An MFA in Writing and Poetics underway at the Jack Kerouac School, Naropa.

making.edit: I’m learning Kathak from Rachna Nivas in New York. I’m married to Gourav: we eloped in Telluride, in the snow, and did it again in Jaisalmer with 150 people a year later.

close.edit: Write to me. Especially if you are drawing up your own contract with the world instead of signing the one you were handed: what it gives you, what you give back, and which of the settled questions you are asking again. Tell me what’s going on.
